interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also narrowing the driver's visual field to encourage slower speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone or underground the lines to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Striping
interventions.description: Apply lane markings to the main road to narrow travel lanes and organize traffic, which naturally reduces vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees and a furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone near the curb to ensure a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Adding a planting strip or furniture zone would move pedestrians further from traffic and provide space for utility poles outside the walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the right side to meet ADA standards and relocate utility poles or create a furniture zone to keep the walking path clear.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Greenery
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Marking
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway entrance and use high-visibility pavement markings or a continuous sidewalk material to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Utility Box Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility box to the edge of the sidewalk or into a furniture zone to ensure a clear, unobstructed through-zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Implement a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improve the aesthetic of the vacant lots, and provide a traffic calming effect by narrowing the perceived street width.
